The '''Coachelle system''' was situated in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]]. A part of the [[Silly Rabbit]] [[Constellation/Legends|constellation]], it contained five [[Planet/Legends|planets]], among which was [[Coachelle Prime/Legends|Coachelle Prime]]. The latter was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]] [[Species/Legends|species]], including the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]]. At some point, the Lepi [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] all the worlds of the Coachelle [[Star system/Legends|system]] as well as most of its [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], and Jaxxon eventually departed his homeworld aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].

==Description==
The Coachelle system was a part of the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]] of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]], within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It constituted a part of the [[Constellation/Legends|constellation]]<ref name="Gamer4" /> that the inhabitants of<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="TEA Oseon">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]]</ref> [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oseon 6845]] had named the [[Silly Rabbit]],<ref name="LCFO" /> and it contained an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] as well as five [[Planet/Legends|planets]],<ref name="UAA" /> one of which was the terrestrial world [[Coachelle Prime/Legends|Coachelle Prime]].<ref name="Gamer4" />

The [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked the Coachelle [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Terr'skiar system/Legends|Terr'skiar system]] and originally also connected it to the [[Ota system/Legends|Ota system]] of the neighboring [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]; however, after the destruction of the [[Kyyr system]] by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]<ref name="TEA" /> in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> the resultant formation of the [[Thornhedge Pulsar]] and the [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|Thornhedge Nebula]] severed the Coachelle&ndash;Ota segment of the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route. Afterward, Coachelle Prime became shrouded in the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula's]] streamers of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] and dust.<ref name="TEA" /> The system shared its name with [[Coachelle Automata/Legends|Coachelle Automata]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company that designed the [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]].<ref name="Scavenger">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Jaxxon-gamer.jpg|thumb|right|215px|Coachelle Prime was the homeworld of the Lepi Jaxxon.]]
The [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Coachelle Prime who spoke the [[Lepese]] [[Language/Legends|language]],<ref name="Gamer4" /> were known off-world<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=starfighter|type=other|Emote: [[Lepi Hop]] from the [[Cartel Market]]}}</ref> by [[3637 BBY]].<ref name="LepiHopDate">{{TOR_updates|2.6}}</ref> In response to overpopulation on Coachelle Prime, the Lepi invented the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and went on to [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] all the other worlds in their [[Star/Legends|star]] system<ref name="Gamer4" /> as well as a large portion of its asteroid belt. That expansion appeared to have provided ample room for<ref name="UAA" /> the [[Spacefaring/Legends|spacefaring]] species, which had many [[Starship/Legends|starships]] left poorly guarded in the Coachelle system.<ref name="Gamer4" />

The Lepi future [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Coachelle Prime. Longing to travel off-world, when he was twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, Jaxxon stole away from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], traveling to the Outer Rim Territories<ref name="Gamer4" /> at some point by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Invitation Only Date">{{TCWdates|122}} Therefore, the events of ''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]'', which lead into those of "Hostage Crisis" and feature a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] posting poster for [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] on [[Keyorin]], must be set in that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Coachelle system was introduced in the article "[[The Starhoppers of Aduba-3]]," which was authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] with [[Cory J. Herndon]] and [[Michael Mikaelian]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 4|fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Gamer4" /> on [[June 19]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010503.html|text=The Wild Side of ''Star Wars Gamer''}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in in grid square P-10.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:BugsBunny-BullyForBugs.png|thumb|right|300px|The name of the Coachelle system was chosen as a reference to a line in the cartoon short "Bully for Bugs" by the character Bugs Bunny (pictured).]]
In [[2006]], Hidalgo confirmed that, given the character Jaxxon had originally been created as an homage to the [[Wikipedia:Looney Tunes|''Looney Tunes'']] cartoon short character [[Wikipedia:Bugs Bunny|Bugs Bunny]], the name of the Coachelle system had also been chosen in reference to that franchise. The ''Star Wars Gamer'' article contains the phrase "[&hellip;] having colonized all five worlds of the Coachelle system and the asteroid belt therein [&hellip;]," which references Bugs Bunny's line from the [[1950s|1953]] short "[[Wikipedia:Bully for Bugs|Bully for Bugs]]:"<ref name="Gamer Endnotes">{{Blog|pablog|60|Tales of the Big Green Bunny: Behind the Scenes of Gamer #4 &mdash; The Coachella Valley, and the Giant Carrot Festival}}</ref> "Pardon me, sir, but could you direct me to the shortest route to the [[Wikipedia:Coachella Valley|Coachella Valley]] and the Big Carrot Festival&hellip; therein?"<ref name="BullyForBugs">"[[Wikipedia:Bully for Bugs|Bully for Bugs]]"</ref>
